style_anchor: Coastal miniature diorama with flat pine-green controls, procedural terrain and local action audio.

assets.produced_prompt:
Create one square 4 by 4 icon atlas for Island Sculptor, a quiet mobile landscape-building game. Exactly sixteen distinct simple FLAT 2D symbols in ONE solid dark pine ink color (#345347), on a genuinely transparent canvas. No other color, white fills, gradients, texture, 3D, bevel, shadow, borders around cells, scenery, text, letters, labels, decoration, or frames. Look like clean vector toolbar glyphs: rounded line caps, clear negative space, and the same medium-bold stroke weight on every icon. Every icon must be recognizable at 22 CSS px. Give each cell equal size, generous clean gutters (at least 16% of each cell on every edge), one centered symbol, consistent optical weight. Use exact order left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: an upward arrow over a single terrain layer or diamond, a downward arrow over the same terrain layer or diamond, a two-leaf sprout, a four-point sparkle.
Row 2: an outlined eye with a single round pupil, three horizontally arranged filled dots, an undo arrow with the arrowhead on the left, a mirrored redo arrow with the arrowhead on the right.
Row 3: plus, minus, a simple pine tree silhouette with a short trunk, a rounded three-lobed bush silhouette.
Row 4: a simple five-petal flower with a short stem, two overlapping rounded angular rocks, a fan-shaped scallop shell with three short interior ribs, a five-armed sea star silhouette.
Keep the empty parts fully transparent. Keep the icons calm and crisp, with the clarity of a professional navigation icon set.
